data.notes_export: wyniki_notek.jsonl (234 notes, 16 August to 1 November 2026, 202 with a 72 hour measurement)

experiment: AAM-F1 is there learnable signal in the live account's real engagement numbers

parameters.bootstrap: moving blocks of 5 consecutive evaluation notes, 2000 draws

power.pool: last 100 notes with a 72 hour measurement

readings.early_24h_stands_in: Spearman between the reading taken 12 to 24 hours after publication and the 72 hour value >= 0.9 for views and >= 0.8 for likes, on at least 30 notes
readings.features_carry_signal: skill over the recency baseline >= 0.05 with the 95% interval above 0, per outcome, for the type-only model and the full model
readings.instrument_detects_planted_effect: the type-only model on data with a planted +50% effect in the commonest type meets the same condition, per outcome
readings.like_rate_varies_beyond_chance: Pearson dispersion D >= 1.5 and Monte Carlo p < 0.01
readings.likes_usable_per_note: share of notes with at least one like at 72 hours >= 0.5
readings.power_valid: false positive rate at no effect between 0.02 and 0.09 in every cell

tier: E (model-free, existing data, no paid calls)
